title: AdaPTS: Adapting Univariate Foundation Models to Probabilistic Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
reviewed_version: PMLR 267 / ICML 2025 published proceedings version; 18 PDF pages
summary: The optimal linear-adapter theorem returns a singular inadmissible matrix for D>1; existence and convexity claims also fail. A tabulated MAE violates its paired MSE bound. Current released predictive summaries and outer-fold head training have local implementation defects; historical empirical consequences unresolved.
limitations: No author code execution, training, tests, data download, or empirical reproduction.
Current released commit is later than proceedings work; historical experiment identity not established.
Additional OpenReview-only attachments unavailable under acquisition manifest HTTP 403 challenge.
External conditional-density theorem and later revisions not independently consulted.

problems.claim: Proposition 3.3 / Appendix A.1 returns an invertible global optimum using (B^T A)^+ B^T B under a shared-bias affine FM.
problems.location: PDF pp.2-4,14-15; Eq.(4)/(6), Remarks 3.4 and A.4
assumptions: No rank/nonzero condition on W_FM or A is assumed
problems.check: General rank proof, exact SymPy pseudoinverse and feasible-loss calculation, scalar curvature, and analytic nonattainment example.
problems.result: Rank of proposed W and ridge modification at most1, hence singular for D>1. Explicit W*=[[1/5,1/5],[2/5,2/5]] whereas diag(1,1/2) is feasible with loss0 (identity loss1). A=0,B=(1,1) gives infimum0 never attained. Scalar f(w)=(1-1/w)^2 has f''(2)=-1/8.
counterevidence: Remark A.4 recognizes degeneracy and proposes changing to channel-dependent bias, but this changes the theorem assumptions and full-rank B alone is insufficient.
Separately trained practical encoder/decoder is explicitly allowed later and does not depend on actual invertibility.
An adapter can improve on identity in some instances; the theorem formula can still be false.
problems.core_dependency: Theoretical foundations are a stated contribution (p2); p3 explicitly calls Prop3.3 foundational motivation; p4 Figure2 claims evaluation of Eq4. Invalidity affects this core theory/optimality interpretation without requiring all empirical results to fail.

correction.statement: For b!=0 optimize q^T=1^T W^-1 over nonzero rows; q*^T=b^T A/(b^T b). If q*!=0, choose an invertible completion; if q*=0 no minimum is attained. If b=0 all invertible W have equal loss.
correction.verification: Analytic characterization and explicit numerical case; no author adoption or experimental repair verified

problems.impact: Theoretical foundations are a stated contribution (p2); p3 explicitly calls Prop3.3 foundational motivation; p4 Figure2 claims evaluation of Eq4. Invalidity affects this core theory/optimality interpretation without requiring all empirical results to fail.

problems.claim: Tables1/6 give corresponding test MSE and MAE averaged across3runs.
problems.location: PDF p6 Table1 and p18 Table6, Illness H24 LinearAE; p6 ETTh1 improvement prose
assumptions: Same reported forecast comparison, residual normalization, and run aggregation as table captions indicate
Three-run mean allows Jensen bound even when runs differ
problems.check: Cauchy-Schwarz per run, Jensen across runs, rounding envelope; source pages visually inspected.
problems.result: Reported mean MAE2.624 must be <=sqrt(2.624)=1.6198765. Rounded limits still conflict (minimum MAE2.6235 versus upper bound1.6200309). ETTh1 .411 to .395 is3.892944%, not8%.
counterevidence: A copied cell is plausible but not established.
A different scale or run protocol could alter comparison but must be disclosed/relabelled.
Main MSE ranking need not change.
problems.impact: Localized numerical reporting defect; correct MAE requires original residuals.

correction.statement: Recompute MAE from bound run predictions and correct percentage to approximately3.89% for displayed numbers.
correction.verification: Inequality and percentage verified; replacement MAE unavailable

problems.claim: ADAPTS.predict_multi_step returns predictive mean and lower/upper summaries after decoding.
problems.location: src/adapts/adapts.py lines217-254; nonlinear decoder in adapters.py lines1409-1422
assumptions: Negative linear decoder permitted for bound reversal
Synthetic transformations are independent mathematical diagnostics, not executions of the author model
problems.check: Static control-flow inspection and independently evaluated tanh / negative-linear examples.
problems.result: Decode(mean U) differs from mean(decode U): samples0,2 give .761594 vs .482014 for tanh. g(u)=-u maps latent mean0,sd1 lower/upper endpoints to1,-1.
counterevidence: compute_ks_metric decodes individual draws; this specific summary error does not automatically invalidate its ECE values.
Historical commit and figure-generation provenance unavailable.
problems.impact: Current returned moments/bounds lack the advertised general interpretation; published scores/plots remain Needs Evidence.

correction.statement: Decode joint draws first with consistent model/normalization state, then compute output-space mean, standard deviation or quantiles.
correction.verification: Mathematical correction justified; author program not run or edited

problems.claim: Hyperparameter optimization uses outer-fold validation of the fitted forecasting pipeline.
assumptions: Moment branch with trainable forecast head (freeze_head=False)
Head fitting receives full pooled X_train/y_train and no explicit validation arrays
problems.check: Trace inputs through ADAPTS.fine_tune_iclearner to MomentICLTrainer.fine_tune; independent set-intersection bound.
problems.result: Outer validation labels enter supervised head training. Example n30: head inner train27, outer validation10 => intersection>=7 independently of inner random split. Only adapter is rebuilt each fold; learner/head created before loop.
counterevidence: Adapter itself trains on fold-specific arrays.
Separate test arrays stay outside the head training pool.
Default objective selects validation MSE; saved test metrics alone do not show test-based selection.
Current later snapshot not bound to proceedings experiments.
problems.impact: Released outer-fold score is not held out for the entire pipeline; historical hyperparameter/result consequences Needs Evidence.

correction.statement: Reinitialize trainable head and adapter each outer fold; restrict supervised fitting and inner validation to outer-training data.
correction.verification: Control-flow and set arithmetic verified; repaired training untested

unresolved_claims.reason: Jensen algebra is valid for written model; relation of unconditional prior marginal to q(Z|X)-based prediction and assumptions on fixed FM need clarification. Cited external theorem not fully audited.
Reported curves read but no independent forecasts/calibration computation or cross-model replication.
